instagram.caption:
A $100 million funding round just landed on a security startup—because companies are realizing their AI systems have blind spots that standard defenses can't see. 🔍

Most security tools scan networks and code, but they ignore the machine learning models themselves. HiddenLayer just raised $100M to fix exactly that gap. 🛡️

The risk is concrete: your AI's blind spots can quietly leak sensitive data through everyday interactions, without any alarm ever ringing. 💸

If you're building content or tools with AI, ask yourself: when was the last time you audited the model itself, not just the code around it?

Do you know where your AI's blind spots are? 🎯
